npcs.name: Wenna Trevose
npcs.idle: The sea took Lyonesse in a night. It didn't take everyone. It didn't let anyone go, either.

npcs.name: Sir Kendric
npcs.idle: I watch for the Arawnites. One of us has to.

quests.title: The Last Evening of Lyonesse
quests.offer:
The drowned of Lyonesse - the danaoin - live their last day over and over. Sowing, fishing, mending nets. Waiting for an evening that never comes.

My sister Morvah wandered off a month ago. Yesterday I saw her from the hill - working the nets with the drowned on the north-west strand. Doing what they do. She didn't know me. Will you [bring her back]?
quests.summary: Wenna Trevose's sister has begun living the drowned folk's endless last day.

steps.goal: Cross the drowned meadows west of the camp
steps.text: Pale spirits drift over the meadow - peallaidh, the drowned land's restless dead. They hum as they go, the same four notes over and over.

steps.goal: Lay the meadow's restless dead to rest
steps.text: As each one fades it sighs, very softly: 'Is it evening yet?' The humming goes on, far off to the north-west, toward the strand.

steps.goal: Search the path down to the north-west strand
steps.text: Morvah's shawl, folded and left on a stone - the way the drowned leave their things before the tide comes. Below, on the strand, a woman sits mending nets among the drowned sailors.

steps.say:
Mind the nets, please. They must be mended by evening.

Wenna? I... I had a sister called Wenna. If I stop, you see, the day ends. And when the day ends, the water comes. They don't want the water to come again. I don't want it to come for them. Do you understand? It's nearly [evening].

steps.goal: Stand with Morvah as the day breaks
steps.text: The drowned sailors stand still in the surf. The sky goes red, then gold, then dark. For the first time in a thousand years, it is evening in Lyonesse.

stages.name: Keep Morvah alive
stages.announce: You take the needle from Morvah's hand. Every danaoin on the strand turns its head.

stages.name: the Drowned Reeve
stages.announce: A drowned man in a reeve's chain stalks up out of the waves. 'THE DAY IS NOT DONE. THE NETS ARE NOT MENDED.'

steps.say:
It's evening. They're going to sleep - all of them, all along the strand. They aren't afraid any more.

Wenna. I remember Wenna now. But someone has to stay and mend the nets, or tomorrow it starts again. I could [stay], and they'd sleep every night from now on. Or I could [come home], and they'd wake tomorrow and never know.

options.say: Then take me home. Before I change my mind. Before the morning.
Tell Wenna I remembered her. Tell her I'm the ferrywoman of Lyonesse now. Tell her to come to the strand at evening, sometimes.

steps.say:
She's here. She's asleep in my tent, holding my hand like when we were small.

She said the drowned will wake tomorrow and never know they had an evening. I said that's not our trouble. I hope I'm right.

She stayed. She remembered me, and she stayed.

I went up the hill at dusk and looked. The strand was quiet. And there was one lantern, down at the water, mending nets. I'll go every evening.

home.text: Take something. You've given me back my sister.

stayed.text: She'd want you to have this.

quests.title: The Sacrament of Arawn
quests.offer:
This is work for a GROUP - gather friends before you go.

The priests of Arawn are gathering at the ruined cathedral in the south. My squire Tobin went to scout and didn't come back. Under the cathedral, the old knights of Lyonesse lie drowned with their king. The Arawnites mean to wake them - as theirs.

Will you [go after Tobin]? Their grove on the eastern cliffs will tell you what they intend.
quests.summary: GROUP. The priests of Arawn mean to raise Lyonesse's drowned knights at the ruined cathedral, and Sir Kendric's squire went to scout them.

steps.goal: Find the Arawnites' grove on the eastern cliffs
steps.text: Arawnite shamanesses dance around a fire of bones. A sealed scroll hangs from a stake in the middle.

steps.goal: Take the orders from the grove
steps.text: 'At the ruined cathedral, on the dark of the moon. The squire will do. His blood will wake the knights, and they will kneel to Arawn.'

steps.goal: Cut down the drowned footmen guarding the southern road
steps.text: They wear the drowned king's colours, but their eyes are already Arawn's.
Priests in black kneel among the broken pillars. Tobin is tied to the altar-stone, white-faced and very angry.
The hierophant collapses across the altar. Under the floor, something that was stirring goes still again.

stages.name: Hierophant Morcant of Arawn
stages.announce: A priest in a mask of bone rises from the altar. 'You are too late, and also just in time - Arawn accepts all blood.'

steps.say:
About time! - sorry. Sorry. Thank you.

There's a reliquary under the altar, sir - I mean, friend. Black glass. It's what wakes them. Sir Kendric needs to [see it].

steps.goal: Bring Tobin and the reliquary to Sir Kendric
steps.say:
Tobin! Thank every god there is.

And that - that's the reliquary? With it, a knight of Albion could wake the drowned knights of Lyonesse. As OURS. Two hundred knights for the realm's wars.

Or we [shatter it], and they sleep forever. I know which I should choose. I don't trust myself. You decide: [wake them for Albion], or shatter it.

options.say: Yes. Yes. Let the dead keep their own. ... There. Did you feel that? Like a held breath going out.
Then I'll keep it, and I'll keep it well, and gods help me if I'm wrong. Tobin, don't look at me like that.

shattered.text: From the camp. You've earned more than we have.
